Welcome to Solar Business Philippines. ☀️

Para ito sa contractors, electricians, engineers, technicians, salespeople, construction professionals, aspiring installers, at sa lahat ng gustong maintindihan kung paano gumagana ang solar business sa Pilipinas.

Dito tayo mag-uusap tungkol sa:

• solar fundamentals
• system design at installation
• costing at proposals
• sales at customer education
• project operations at business growth

Practical ang approach natin—walang puro hype at walang puro theory.
